"Hi Daniel,

I'm a junior in logistics management at Bayshore State, and I found your profile while looking at alumni working in freight. I'd love to hear how you got into the industry. Would you have 15 minutes for a quick chat in the next couple of weeks?

I've attached my resume (v19), a one-pager that includes a warehouse-sim project where I cut simulated tote dwell time by 22%.

Thank you for your time,

Changes: I dropped "a few questions" since the ask is clearer with just the 15 minutes, and I made the project line shorter. Also, I kept the name Daniel as you wrote it. Double-check the spelling against his profile.
